name: Historical Complex of Split with the Palace of Diocletian
description: In Split, on Croatia's Adriatic coast, a Roman emperor's retirement home still forms the heart of a living town. Diocletian built the palace around the end of the 3rd century AD, half as a private residence and half as a garrison fortress. Today its walls shelter about 3,000 residents, along with shops, cafes and a medieval cathedral that reuses the emperor's own mausoleum.
